decisions.possible_ai: A verified C2PA AI declaration or any registered P3 pixel detector score at/above its pre-registered high-confidence threshold.
decisions.no_ai_signal: No high-confidence AI signal and no qualifying positive camera-capture evidence.
decisions.possible_camera: No high-confidence AI signal, plus either a trusted C2PA digitalCapture/computationalCapture declaration (high strength) or coherent camera/time/physical EXIF after a completed AI check (limited strength).

coherent_exif_requirements: at least three positive values among ExposureTime, FNumber, ISO, and FocalLength

non_contributing_methods.camera_consistency: Displayed for review only: the local labeled-control audit did not establish stable source separation.
non_contributing_methods.geometry: Displayed for review only: official line classification, learned line sets, and explicit projective-consistency features all failed the held-out SDXL gate.
non_contributing_methods.implicit_watermark: No compatible local detector is configured, so it does not affect any decision.

limitations: EXIF metadata can be copied or edited; it can support only a limited possible-camera result and never overrides positive AI evidence.
Offline C2PA validation cannot establish current revocation state or signer trust when no trust list is configured.
possible_camera is not provenance or authenticity proof.
no_ai_signal is not evidence of camera origin.
